_comment: Effect recipes for WRFx (WRFx.h lists the names gameplay uses). Each effect is layers of sprites from the atlas (Tools/fx/make_fx_atlas.mjs: dot, spark, smoke, smoke2, flame, flame2, flare, ring, chip_wood, chip_stone, leaf, shard, flake, droplet, glow, wisp). blend 'add' glows (fire, sparks, magic), 'lit' is smoke and debris lit by the scene. count = burst, rate = per second while a looping effect runs (loop: true). life/size/speed/spin/rot are [min, max] (s, cm, cm/s, deg/s, deg). grow = end size x start. dir is in the effect's frame (X = its rotation's forward; impacts face along the surface normal or away from the blow), spread = cone half-angle. gravity x 980 cm/s2 (negative rises), drag 1/s, turbulence cm/s2, stretch = streak length x speed. radius (sphere, or disc/ring), box half-extents, line (along X) and lift place the spawn; radial flies out from the centre. scale (from the caller) multiplies sizes (scaleSize false: not) and spawn shapes, speeds only with scaleSpeed, counts by scale^countExp. follow = moves with the effect. sortBias (cm) layers flat lit sprites (bigger = drawn first, underneath). bounce = lands on the ground and bounces. colors = linear RGBA over the sprite's life. intensity = HDR glow (add) or self-glow (lit). light = a pooled point light (seconds = fade for one-shots, flicker for loops). shake = tuning.json fx.shake.<name>. Live-reload with the console command WR.FxReload.

impacts._comment: What a hit on a creature throws up, by creature id ('creature' = any other, 'survivor' = players).

lightning.hit._comment: Every Lightning hit: a 0.08 s violet-white flash on the body (cooks/biome-lightning.md 2.18.3 proc feedback).

lightning.arc._comment: The chain's ribbon from body to body: lays along X over 100 cm x scale (scale = the gap in metres), gone in 0.12 s.

plasma.arc._comment: Plasma (Fire + Lightning): burning lightning from body to body, along X over 100 cm x scale.

lightning.steam._comment: Conductive: steam crackling off a soaked body.

lightning.afterimage._comment: Afterimage: a translucent body-shaped spark where the dodge began, crackling until it bursts.

lightning.blockspark._comment: Discharge: the block spark turns violet.

lightning.discharge._comment: Charged weapon's release on the body it lands on.

lightning.weapon._comment: A lightning Wildbrand's crackle along the blade.

lightning.field._comment: Static field: a disc of crawling static (scale = radius in metres).

lightning.tempest._comment: Tempest: a dark crackling cloud and wind round its caster (attached; scale = radius in metres).

lightning.thundergod._comment: Thunder god: the caster crackles with a violet-white aura while it lasts (attached).

lightning.groundglow._comment: Thunder god's bolts: the 0.15 s ground glow under the target before the bolt lands, so others can read it.

lightning.dash._comment: Bolt dash: the body crackles as it goes (attached).

blood.cast._comment: Blood & curse (WRAbilitiesBlood.cpp, cooks/biome-swamp.md 2.17): garnet (#7A0A14, never crimson) drawn up out of the wrist into the casting hand.

blood.thread._comment: Lifesteal: thin garnet threads from the target into your hand, 0.2 s (lays along X over 100 cm x scale).

blood.hit._comment: A Blood spell's or Wildbrand's splash on the body.

blood.spear._comment: Blood spear: a lance of blood along the aim (X over 100 cm x scale), spattering as it goes.

blood.boil._comment: Blood boil: a dark ring rolls out over the ground (scale = radius / 100 cm).

blood.boil_pop._comment: Each bleeding body's wounds flare and burst (the pop chain).

blood.tide._comment: Crimson tide: a wall of blood laid along X (scale = width / 100 cm) running forward along Y at 900 cm/s for 1,500 cm (life = length / speed).

blood.transfusion._comment: Transfusion: a garnet stream from your hand into the ally (X over 100 cm x scale), redrawn each quarter second.

blood.misfortune._comment: Misfortune: the cursed blow whiffs; a black-purple hex spark where it should have landed.

blood.doom._comment: Doom: a black-purple sigil over the target counting down three pulses (loop for the delay).

blood.contagion._comment: Contagion: a black-purple thread jumps to the next body (X over 100 cm x scale).

blood.ruin._comment: Ruin: a slow-turning black-purple sigil over every cursed enemy, for the whole party (loop for the curse).

blood.feast._comment: Feast: a garnet burst into you from the kill.

blood.sanguine._comment: Sanguine lord: a faint garnet aura for its 10 s (the veins light on the body itself).

blood.weapon._comment: A Blood Wildbrand: the blade runs garnet for the swing (attached to the weapon).

blood.iceveins._comment: Ice veins (Frost + Blood): a thin rime armour glints over you for a few seconds.

nature.cast._comment: The Nature path (WRAbilitiesNature.cpp, cooks/biome-forest.md 2.17): green light gathers in the casting hand, a few leaves turning round it (attached, for the wind-up).

nature.rooted._comment: Rooted heals: thin root-hairs creep from the soles into the ground (kept up a second at a time while it heals).

nature.entangle._comment: Entangled (any source): roots burst out of the ground and wrap the legs, held for the hold (scale = the body's width / 90 cm).

nature.entangle_snap._comment: Roots on a boss: they snap off it (the slow instead of a hold).

nature.thorned_skin._comment: Thorned skin: thorns flick out of the armour at the hit point, toward the attacker.

nature.purify._comment: Purify: grey-green motes lift out of the body (the poison and rot drawn out).

nature.heal._comment: A Nature heal tick lands: small leaves of gold-green light rise round the body.

nature.regrowth._comment: Regrowth on its ally for the heal's seconds: leaves of light circling up the body (attached).

nature.mend._comment: Regrowth cast at an ally: a thread of gold-green light from the hand to them (X over 100 cm x scale).

nature.sanctuary._comment: Sanctuary: a ring of moss and gold-green light on the ground while it lasts (scale = radius in metres).

nature.snare._comment: Root snare: roots heave up through the ground across the pool and grope for feet while it lasts (scale = radius in metres).

nature.strangle._comment: Strangling vines: thick vines coil up round the body and tighten for the crush (attached; scale by the body).

nature.weapon._comment: A Nature Wildbrand: thorns bristle green along the blade for the swing (attached to the weapon).

nature.vine._comment: Vine lash: a thorned vine cracks out along X from the weapon hand (100 cm x scale = its length), gone in 0.25 s.

nature.wither._comment: A plant folds back into the ground, a seed dies in the hand: brown leaves and dust.

nature.thorn_trail._comment: A thorn in flight (Thorn shot, the Sprout turret): a faint green streak behind it (attached).

nature.thorn_hit._comment: A thorn bites: a dry crack, a spray of splinters and green flecks.

nature.pollen._comment: Pollen: a pale-yellow haze drifting round a plant over the area it slows (attached; scale = radius in metres).

nature.sprout._comment: The Sprout turret bursts out of the ground: soil and leaves thrown up.

nature.turret_muzzle._comment: The Sprout turret spits a thorn: a green puff at the pod's mouth.

nature.world_tree._comment: The World tree grows out of the ground in 0.8 s: the earth heaves, leaves burst, a gold-green flash.

nature.world_tree_crown._comment: Under the World tree's crown while it stands: motes of gold-green light drifting down over the healing area (attached; scale = radius in metres).

nature.guardian_rise._comment: The Ancient guardian pulls itself up out of the ground: the earth tears open, roots and clods fly, dust.

nature.guardian_slam._comment: The Ancient guardian's fists hit the ground: a ring of dust and clods where they landed (scale = radius in metres).

nature.guardian_eyes._comment: The Ancient guardian's eyes: two amber embers in its eye-knots (attached; it lives as long as the guardian).

nature.forest_fire._comment: Forest fire (Fire + Nature 50): a killed plant bursts into flame (scale = radius in metres).

nature.bark_hit._comment: A blow on a plant: bark chips and torn leaves (fx impacts for the plant kinds).

gnarl.bark_chips._comment: A blow on Old Gnarl's bark: chips of dark furrowed bark and a puff of wood dust (an axe throws more).

gnarl.bark_strip._comment: A bark plate torn off: slabs of bark flung out, the pale wood under it showing (scale ~1.5 on a plate).

gnarl.plate_burn._comment: A stripped spot of Old Gnarl burning (attached to the plate while it burns; scale = its size / 2 m).

gnarl.reel._comment: Old Gnarl reels (two spots burning, the regrow cancelled): leaves and twigs shaken out of its crown, a groan of timber.

gnarl.sap_bubble._comment: The regrow: amber sap bubbling out of the stripped wood and bark crawling over it (seconds = the 1.5 s wind-up).

gnarl.bark_regrow._comment: The bark closes over the spot: a ripple of bark flakes settling and a last bead of sap.

gnarl.stump_tear._comment: Old Gnarl tears a stump and its root ball out of the ground: soil sprays, roots snap (the boulder's wind-up).

gnarl.stump_land._comment: The thrown stump comes down: soil, splinters, a ring of dust (scale = its burst radius / 3 m).

gnarl.soil_pour._comment: Soil pouring off its lifted root mass (the root slam's tell; seconds = the wind-up).

gnarl.grasp._comment: A fist of branches closes round a body: twigs snapping, leaves torn loose.

queen.comb_hit._comment: A blow on a brood comb: wax flakes and paper shreds.

queen.comb_break._comment: A brood comb breaks: the cells burst, grubs' glow spills, paper and wax rain down.

queen.hive_motes._comment: The Paper Hollow's air (looping on the scenery): paper dust drifting in the grubs' light, now and then a wasp crossing.

queen.pheromone_fan._comment: She hovers and fans her abdomen: a pale dust building behind her (the mark's 0.9 s tell; seconds = the wind-up).

queen.pheromone_cloud._comment: The mark: a pale dust cloud thrown forward over the 6 m cone (scale = reach / 6 m).

queen.swarm_out._comment: Wasps pour out of a comb: a dark burst of bodies and a paper puff.

queen.sting_stuck._comment: The stinger driven into paper or wood on a miss: splinters and a fleck of venom.

queen.hive_hold._comment: Three Hivebacks balled on her: their heat shimmers round her body (the 2 s hold).

matron.bark_rain._comment: Bark and leaves rain from where she hangs (the canopy drop's 0.95 s tell; seconds = the wind-up).

matron.scream._comment: The kit scream: breath and spittle in the cold air off her jaws.

matron.ferns_part._comment: A Thornlynx kit bursting out of the ferns at the ring's edge.

matron.curtain_fall._comment: The larder's hide curtain drops: dust and old hair out of the skins.

warden.hoof_scrape._comment: Three hoof scrapes before the charge: clods and torn turf thrown back (seconds = the wind-up).

warden.bellow_breath._comment: The Bellow: hot breath streaming from his muzzle, the herd's answer coming.

warden.enrage._comment: His herd hurt: he throws his head, the mane up, foam and breath.

warden.held._comment: Roots hold the Hornwarden: turf heaves round his hooves and the roots creak.

warden.hunt_mist._comment: The Wild Hunt rides: a cold mist streams off him (looped for its seconds).

warden.antler_break._comment: An antler breaks off at the burr: shards of antler and ivy and banner rags torn away.

warden.antler_crack._comment: The charge meets a trunk or a stone: antler on wood, bark and dust burst off.

sylvaroth.knot_hit._comment: A blow on a Root Knot: wet splinters and a spit of amber sap.

sylvaroth.knot_break._comment: A Root Knot severed: the burl bursts, sap sprays, the line's light goes out from the cut.

sylvaroth.blight._comment: Bootlace blight on a knot (or Gnarl's pale wood): black threads of rhizomorph spread and the wood greys.

sylvaroth.root_tremble._comment: The root hand's ring: the ground under the target trembles, soil jumping inside a crimson-lit rim (scale = ring radius / 1 m).

sylvaroth.root_erupt._comment: Roots burst up out of the ground: clods, moss torn away, splinters.

sylvaroth.ground_bulge._comment: The root eruption's tell: the ground bulges along the line, moss tearing, a crackle running along it (seconds = the wind-up; scale along X).

sylvaroth.pods_swell._comment: Its back canopy shakes as six pods swell orange-brown (the seed bombs' tell).

sylvaroth.seed_burst._comment: A seed pod bursts where it lands: husk shards, a spray of seeds, roots whipping out of the burst (scale = burst radius / 3 m).

sylvaroth.canopy_shed._comment: The canopy shake: its back flings leaves and dead twigs (looped for the shake).

sylvaroth.branch_land._comment: A dead branch from its canopy crashes down: splinters and dust (scale = radius / 3 m).

sylvaroth.uproot_ring._comment: The Uprooting's tell: a crimson-rimmed ring 20 m round its body cracks open (scale = radius / 10 m; seconds = the 1.5 s wind-up).

sylvaroth.uproot_burst._comment: It tears its lower body out of the ground: earth and roots everywhere inside the ring.

sylvaroth.reroot._comment: It drives its arms into the earth: soil heaves and light runs into the ground (seconds = the re-root's 6 s).

sylvaroth.limb_sweep._comment: A heart-tree's lower limbs lash round low: bark, moss and dust in a ring (scale = reach / 5 m).

sylvaroth.hearts_wake._comment: The hidden phase: the four heart-trees wake, their amber hearts flaring (scale = arena radius / 10 m).

sylvaroth.vine_creep._comment: A sector's vines creeping toward your feet (looped on the sector for its 1.5 s): torn moss and a rustle.

sylvaroth.vine_live._comment: A live sector (while it lasts): a faint pale-green glimmer moving along the vines.

sylvaroth.sector_burnt._comment: A sector burnt clean (10 s): embers and ash drifting off the blackened vines.

sylvaroth.vines_burn._comment: Fire takes a vine sector: the vines flare and shrivel.

sylvaroth.vine_uncoil._comment: A vine uncoiling from the lattice toward the furthest tame (seconds = the wind-up; scale along X = distance / 10 m).

sylvaroth.vine_snap._comment: The thorn whip cracks: torn leaves and thorn splinters where it struck.

sylvaroth.arm_collapse._comment: A lattice arm's stance breaks: the roots split and that side slumps.

sylvaroth.resin_weep._comment: After the kill the Four Hearts' bark weeps resin: amber beads glinting down the trunks (looped for its seconds).

sylvaroth.foxfire_haze._comment: The pale foxfire haze over the Clearing of Four Hearts at night (the scenery's; scale = clearing radius / 10 m).

arena.rope_fray._comment: A blow on a walkway's rope anchor: fibres fray off the rope.

arena.rope_snap._comment: A rope anchor cut through: the rope parts with a crack, fibres burst.

arena.walkway_snap._comment: A Bower walkway falls: planks wrench loose along its length, dust and leaves shaken from the canopy (scale = length / 10 m, along X).

swampboss.crows._comment: The Hex-Warden bursting into (or out of) forty crows: wings, a puff of black, loose feathers.

swampboss.crow_stream._comment: The crows flying from where she scattered to the totem she reforms at (X over 100 cm x scale; 0.06 s a metre).

swampboss.cloak_flare._comment: Her feather cloak flaring before the scatter: black feathers shaken loose round her.

swampboss.hex_sigil._comment: The hex bolt's tell: a black-purple sigil gathering in her palm over the wind-up.

swampboss.hexbolt._comment: The hex bolt in flight (a loop on the shot): a black-purple core with a garnet heart, smoking.

swampboss.hexbolt_hit._comment: Where the hex bolt lands: a burst of black-purple and garnet.

swampboss.mask_shatter._comment: The crow-skull mask breaking on a stance break: white bone shards and a garnet flash.

swampboss.hex_haze._comment: The Hex-Warden's Red Tide night walk: a low garnet haze rolling round her feet (a loop on her).

swampboss.vein_pulse._comment: The spray's tell: the vein at the near end pulses garnet.

swampboss.vein_spray._comment: The Bloat's spray: stolen blood jetting from a vein along X (scale = reach / 6 m).

swampboss.vein_burst._comment: A vein ruptured: a red fountain from the flank.

swampboss.vomit._comment: Salt on the Bloat: it heaves up its gorge in a 4 m spray in front (along X).

swampboss.burst._comment: The Bloat bursts: an 8 m ring of stolen blood (scale = radius / 8 m).

swampboss.puddle._comment: A bleedwater slick the Bloat left: leech ripples rising in it (a loop; scale = radius / 1 m).

swampboss.clot._comment: A clot lobbed through the air (a loop on the shot): a black-red glob shedding drops.

forest.smoke._comment: The Ancient forest's hazards and the Bloom (WRForestHazards.cpp; cooks/biome-forest.md 2.8-2.10). Palette: canes #4A261E, char #14100E, embers #C24A12, dead wood #7E7A72, litter #6A5030, wasp paper #969288, pollen #E8E0A0, Grovekin glass green #6EE65A.

forest.hollow_dig._comment: The Hollow Root and the secrets (WRForestHollow.cpp): a Truffler's snout throwing soil and root ends at the soft spot.

forest.secret_bell._comment: The Bell-Tree's bell (F-S5): dust and moss shaken off the bronze, a ring of disturbed air.

forest.light_shafts._comment: Clear weather under the old growth and the Elder Canopy by day (cooks/biome-forest.md 2.9; WRSky ShaftFx): soft green-gold beams slanting down the sun's line round the viewer (the effect's X is the light's direction), and pollen motes hanging in them. Rides with the volumetric fog's own shafts.

vharra.waterarc._comment: Vharra's shocked water (WRSwampVharra.cpp): one jagged run of blue-white arc laid along X over 100 cm x scale.

vharra.watershock._comment: The whole Throat electrified for its seconds (scale = the flood's radius / 1000 cm).

vharra.convulse._comment: Vharra thrashing in the shocked water (scale = her radius / 100 cm).

vharra.surge._comment: The Sinking's surge: a 1.4 m wall of water running out along the Throat at 1,200 cm/s for 3.9 s (scale = radius / 100 cm: the ring ends at the radius).

vharra.heavewave._comment: The anchor heave's ring along the water: knee high, 1,200 cm/s for 2 s (scale = radius / 100 cm).

vharra.spray._comment: Her blood spray: a stream of blood laid along X from her mouth (scale = its reach / 100 cm), falling as it goes.

vharra.sacpulse._comment: Her sacs pulse (the spray's and the brood's tell): a garnet swell under the skin, a few beads of blood.

vharra.sacburst._comment: A blood sac ruptures: a burst of blood and a garnet cloud.

vharra.clotsplat._comment: A clot comes down: a dark splash and its ring.

vharra.drip._comment: Water streaming off her trunk or her reared body (looping for the Broadcast's seconds; scale = width / 100 cm).

vharra.crust._comment: Lightning burns the blood: the water round a rod clots into a dark crust (scale = its radius / 100 cm).

vharra.brood._comment: The brood spilling into the water from her split sacs.

vharra.floodrise._comment: The Throat floods: the water boils up over the terraces for the rise's seconds (scale = radius / 1000 cm).

vharra.rodglow._comment: A fired Rodwarden rod's crown through its cooldown: blue sparks crawling, a pale glow (attached).

swamp.gas.vent._comment: A marsh-gas vent at rest (WRSwampSystems AWRMarshGas, attached per vent): slow fat bubbles breaking in rings, a faint swamp-breath haze.

swamp.gas.tell._comment: The 0.9 s before a field flashes: the whole field boils and a cold blue flicker rises off it (the whoomp plays with it).

swamp.gas.flash._comment: One vent's flash, 4 m (scale = flashRadius / 400): a blue-cored fireball lifting off the water, its smoke, sparks.

swamp.jar.burst._comment: A stormglass jar breaking: glass shards, a violet-white discharge.

swamp.water_shock._comment: A shocked patch of water while it lasts (scale = radius / 600; Seconds keeps it up): rings racing out over the surface, sparks skating on it, a flickering violet light.

swamp.salt.burst._comment: A salt pouch bursting: a white puff and grains falling.

swamp.puddle._comment: A bleedwater puddle or warm pool at rest (scale = radius / 300): thin leech ripples, a metal film catching the light now and then.

swamp.leech.boil._comment: The Red Tide's leech boil surfacing at your legs (with the hum, a second before the latchers), and the Coven bell's shiver in the silt.

swamp.crows.lift._comment: The Red Tide's warning: a whole murder of crows going up at once over a roost (black specks climbing and wheeling).

void.salt.burst._comment: An anchor salt bag bursting (WRVoidWorld): a 3 m grey-white cloud that hangs, grains falling, a violet flicker where it bites the void.

void.mandrake.shiver._comment: A pulled mandrake shivering for 0.9 s before it screams: dust shaken off its leaves.

void.mandrake.scream._comment: The scream: a pale ring racing out 12 m and a puff of soil.

void.stone.float._comment: Grit lifting off a thrown stone that floats in a rift zone (loops while it hangs).

void.keepsake._comment: A keepsake at a story site: a faint pale glint that comes and goes, so you notice it without a marker.

void.blink.ripple._comment: Where a blink will land: a lensing ripple on the ground, shown for the whole tell (>= 0.5 s).

void.blink.shudder._comment: A blink's tell on the body: a breath of dark dust off its skin.

void.blink.smear._comment: Its outline smearing as it goes and comes: an inward ink smear and a lensing ring.

void.rift.plunge._comment: Something going back into a tear: the edge gulps, grit sucked in.

void.rift.burst._comment: A Riftmaw bursting out of a tear: black glass grit and dust thrown forward, a violet flash at the edge.

void.hush.scream._comment: The Hush scream: a pale pressure ring racing out, dust lifting off the ground.

void.hush.tap._comment: Two taps of the long finger on the ground: a little puff each.

void.cast._comment: The coil: the hand closing on a point of black, grit drawn in to it.

void.collapse._comment: Collapse: grit and dust streaming in to your feet from 5 m, a dark ring closing.

void.crush._comment: The crush at the end of a pull: an ink burst and a sharp ring.

void.phase._comment: Phase: you turn grey-translucent, light bending off your edges.

void.nowhere._comment: Nowhere: the body gone to a shimmer of bent light.

void.nowhere.crit._comment: The blow out of Nowhere: a violet flare.

void.sacrifice._comment: Sacrifice: grey ash rising off the hands while it lasts.

void.weapon._comment: Null strike: the blade runs black, a violet edge.

void.consume._comment: Consume: the body drawn in to a point of black, ink pouring off it.

void.unravel._comment: Unravelled: a grey thread-fray off the target.

void.feed._comment: Feed: grey threads from the kill into your chest.

void.swallow._comment: Event horizon: a projectile swallowed, a small inward flash.

forest.chimney._comment: A lived-in chimney's smoke (WRForestScenery: the village's cottages, the Hermit's Oak's clay chimney, the camps' huts): thin wood smoke leaning with the air.

forest.campfire._comment: A camp's fire (the coastal camps, the Ringfort's merchant fire): flames, sparks, smoke, a warm light.

forest.resin_smoke._comment: The Grove Circle's brazier burning heartwood resin: a slow amber-tinted smoke column over the AWRShrine's fire.

forest.falls_spray._comment: Where a waterfall hits its plunge pool (WRForestScenery Fall/GreatFalls): white spray thrown up and out, droplets falling back.

forest.falls_mist._comment: The drifting mist a big fall keeps over its pool and down the valley.

forest.spray._comment: A small fall's or a weir's splash (the Mill Race tailrace, Otter Steps).

forest.trickle._comment: Water leaking from the Mill Race's broken flume: a thin falling stream and its drips.

forest.fish_run._comment: Fish rising at a ford or a pool's tail (DC 2.4 kit fords, Otter Steps): rings on the water and now and then a silver flash.

forest.flies._comment: Flies over a carcass, a larder, a kill set-piece: a small dark cloud that never settles.

forest.bees._comment: Bees at a hive (a beehive tree's hole, the skeps of the Herb Terraces, the farmstead's hive): golden specks circling the entrance.

forest.rainbow._comment: The Great Falls' noon rainbow in its spray (11:00-13:00 on a clear day: UWRForestWorld::StepLights): four faint coloured rings stood in the mist, red outermost; the pool and the ground hide their lower halves, so what shows is the bow.

forest.snare_snap._comment: A snare stake springing: the sapling whips up, a shower of leaves and torn earth.

forest.offering._comment: Food left on an Offering Stone: a breath of green-gold pollen rising off the carved loaf and fading (the forest takes it).

forest.blight_splash._comment: A Bootlace blight jar breaking: clay shards, a burst of black spores and green-glowing threads.

forest.pot_break._comment: A smoke pot breaking: clay shards and a billow of thick green-grey smoke that hangs (WRForest::AddSmoke keeps the cloud itself).

forest.cr_shadow._comment: A Thornlynx about to drop (WRForestCreatures): its shadow grows on the ground where it will land over the 0.9 s tell, leaves and bark flakes raining down into it.

forest.cr_leaves._comment: Bark and leaves shaken off a trunk by a Thornlynx above (the drop's tell, a lynx knocked down).

forest.cr_dirt._comment: Earth and leaf litter thrown up by a rooting Truffler (a truffle, a dig) or a Burlbeast's log drag.

forest.cr_marked._comment: A Bramblewasp scout's mark on a body: a pale pheromone dust hanging round it while it lasts (water or smoke washes it off).

forest.cr_heat._comment: Hivebacks clinging in a heat ball: a shimmer of heat and drifting sparks of fur.

forest.cr_scout._comment: The scout's mark landing (on a body, or on a hive tree before a raid): a pale dust puff.

forest.cr_fan._comment: A scout hanging at your head fanning its abdomen (the 0.9 s tell): a thin pale haze building.

forest.cr_scrape._comment: A charge's tell: head down, the forelegs scraping leaf litter and earth back.

forest.cr_roar._comment: A Mossmaul's roar: a ring of breath, and moss and needles shaken down out of the crown.

forest.cr_slam._comment: A Rootcoil's body slam landing: earth, roots and leaf litter thrown out in a ring.

forest.cr_land._comment: A Thornlynx landing off its drop (or knocked down): a burst of leaf litter.

forest.cr_grab._comment: A catch: a Mossmaul's hug or a Rootcoil's coils closing (moss, bark and grit).

forest.cr_snort._comment: A Truffler's snort at a leaf pit or a find: a puff of breath and leaf dust off its snout.

forest.cr_shimmer._comment: A Glimmerfinch flock lifted over a sign: an iridescent shimmer of green, gold and violet glints round it.

forest.cr_shimmer_burst._comment: A Glimmerfinch flock bursting up and away (startled, whistled): a flash of iridescent glints and down.

forest.cr_bloom._comment: Ferns and flowers growing into a Mossmaul's moss under a Nature walker's hand: pollen and green motes rising.

forest.cr_bloom_burst._comment: The calm taking hold (and done): a burst of pollen and petals off the moss.

forest.cr_mark_cache._comment: A cache a tame Truffler smelled (its owner only): a slow gold ring over the ground.

forest.cr_mark_pit._comment: A leaf pit a Truffler snorted at (its owner only): an amber warning ring on the rim.

forest.cr_mark_dig._comment: The Hollow Root's soft spot a Truffler found (its owner only): a green ring and rising motes.

grave.subsidence_crack._comment: The tell (1 s): the turf cracks in a ring, chalk dust puffs up through it, a few clods jump.

grave.chalk_fall._comment: The lid gives way: turf and chalk falling into the pit, a dust column.

grave.chalk_sift._comment: Chalk dust sifting down from the ceiling over one survivor (the ceiling drop's tell): runs for its seconds.

grave.soil_heave._comment: Grave earth heaving up (a Risen climbing out, a Gravehound rising, a clod landing).

grave.dig_spoil._comment: A spadeful of spoil thrown up and aside.

grave.bone_collapse._comment: Bones falling into a heap (a Risen at dawn, the Ossuary Lord's pile), dust off them.

grave.bone_reform._comment: The grave-light knits the pile back together: green threads up through the bones, the bones lifting.

grave.bone_burst._comment: Shards of bone wrenched off its body for the spray.

grave.bone_wave._comment: The collapse-and-surge: a rolling wave of bone across the floor (runs for its seconds, scale = width / 2 m).

grave.bone_hands._comment: Bone hands bursting up out of the floor in a 2.5 m circle (scale = radius / 2.5 m).

grave.bone_break._comment: A hold breaks open (a palp, ribs, a cage door): bone and iron splinters.

grave.keystone_smash._comment: A keystone skull shatters: its soulstone crust bursts in green-blue glass.

grave.grab._comment: Seized: dust off the body, a grave-light flash at the grip.

grave.floor_crack._comment: The tell under Grave hands (0.9 s): the floor cracks in a circle with green light coming up through it.

grave.ground_crack._comment: The spade slam: the ground cracks open in a line (scale = length / 4 m).

grave.toll_ring._comment: The Toll: a ring of force rolling 8 m out from the tower's foot (scale = radius / 2 m), dust lifting with it.

grave.bell_hum._comment: The bell starts to swing (the Toll's tell): dust shaken from the belfry, a faint hum ring.

grave.bell_ring._comment: The hand-bell rung against your head (the Knell): a bright bronze shiver.

grave.rope_fray._comment: A blow on the frayed rope: fibres and dust.

grave.rope_snap._comment: The rope parts: a burst of fibres, the cut end whipping up.

grave.chain_hit._comment: A blade on the chandelier's chain: sparks.

grave.chain_snap._comment: The chain parts at the pulley: sparks and rust flakes.

grave.chandelier_crash._comment: The bone chandelier hits the floor: bones and candles everywhere, a dust ring.

grave.sac_singe._comment: A torch held to an egg sac: the silk blackening and smoking (2 s).

grave.sac_hit._comment: A blade in an egg sac: silk tufts and a wet spray.

grave.sac_burst._comment: An egg sac destroyed: silk shreds, eggs bursting, a sick green-grey splash.

grave.sac_hatch._comment: A sac splits along its seam and young spill out.

grave.brood_shed._comment: The young lift off her back in a pale wave.

grave.young_burn._comment: Fire on her back: the young on it shrivel and fall in embers.

grave.lantern_smash._comment: His lantern smashed: glass and a gout of candle flame that dies.

grave.lantern_light._comment: He lights the spare lantern from the cage: a match flare, the candle catching.

grave.lanterns_gutter._comment: The Opening's tell: every lantern in the chapel gutters (green flicker through the nave), then dies.

grave.keen._comment: The Keen: a cone of pale grief out of her face (moth dust driven before it), for its seconds.

grave.moth_dust._comment: Wing-dust: the grey-brown scale-dust a Wraithmoth (or Nhal's veil) sheds, with violet glints.

grave.shade_pour._comment: The Procession pours out of her: dark shapes streaming out and away round the nave.

grave.gravefire._comment: A grave-fire pool (4 m, its seconds): pale green flames low on the ground.

grave.tomb_open._comment: An open tomb: grave-light rising out of the dark inside, motes drifting up.

grave.tomb_seal._comment: Roots burst from the cracks and bind the slab: splinters, earth, white petals.

grave.lime_steam._comment: Quicklime slaking: white steam and a crackle of crust (the lime pits' tell, a pot on the pile).

grave.lime_burst._comment: A lime pot breaks: a white cloud 4 m across that hangs and burns (scale = radius / 2 m; its seconds).

grave.lime_trail._comment: A thrown lime pot trailing white dust.

grave.draught._comment: A crypt draught's tell (1.2 s): dust and grit streaming along the corridor (X = the way it blows), flames leaning.

grave.keepsake._comment: A keepsake picked up at its story site: a faint grave-light mote rises off where it lay.

necro.soul_wisp._comment: A Soul flies to the Necromancer: a pale-green wisp along the line from the body to the chest (scale = length / 1 m).

necro.soul_wisp_bright._comment: A Soul torn free by Final harvest: brighter, whiter.

necro.raise._comment: Raise dead: grave-light threads pull the body upright out of the ground, the eyes light.

necro.corpse_explosion._comment: A minion detonates: its bones blow outward in a ring of green fire.

necro.funeral_pyre._comment: Funeral pyre: the blast is fire too.

necro.army._comment: Army of the dead: a wave of grave-light rolls out over the ground and the bodies answer (scale = radius / 4 m).

necro.cast._comment: Grave-light gathering in the casting hand, bone-green smoke curling off the fingers (its seconds).

necro.weapon._comment: Grave-light running down a blade (Grave strike, Scythe sweep; its seconds).

necro.scythe_arc._comment: The scythe's sweep: a pale arc of grave-light round you (scale = reach / 1 m).

necro.drain_beam._comment: Life drain: a pale-green beam from the hand to the drained (scale = length / 1 m), motes running back along it.

necro.lich_crown._comment: Lich form: a crown of grave-light flickering over the head, green breath (its seconds).

necro.death_mark._comment: A Death mark: a turning grey sigil over the marked (its seconds).

necro.final_harvest._comment: Final harvest: the body folds; a Soul tears free brighter than normal.

necro.soul_shield._comment: Soul shield: a bone-grey ward ripples where the hit lands.

necro.deathless._comment: Deathless: the skin flashes ash-white for 0.4 s.

necro.cycle_of_life._comment: Cycle of life: a minion falls and green motes heal those near (scale = radius / 4 m).
